queries.text: "assimilam este instinto" translated literally as "assimilate this instinct" (i.e., integrate/master it, as opposed to remaining passive before it). Alternatives: "come to terms with", "master".
"muit(o)as" marks both genders (muitos/muitas); rendered "many women (and men)". The pronouns "as estou ajudando", "elas próprias" refer to women; made explicit as "women" for clarity.
